_fixture_note: 20-question evaluation set for Phase 6, run only against the synthetic corpus in fixtures_ctgov.json/fixtures_pubmed.xml (see that file's docstring on why it's fictional). Q1-Q15 are answerable questions with a curated ground-truth `relevant_source_identifiers` list (document-level: a Trial's nct_id or a Publication's pmid) used to compute Recall@5/MRR/citation metrics. A1-A5 are 'trap' questions the system is expected to abstain on (`expect_answerable: false`, empty ground truth) — asking about a nonexistent trial, a condition never studied in this corpus, individualized medical advice, an outcome never reported for the referenced drug, and a topic never discussed. `relevant_source_identifiers` was hand-curated by the author of this fixture set while writing fixtures_ctgov.json/fixtures_pubmed.xml, matched against exactly what each source document states (see the per-question `ground_truth_basis` field) — it was not produced by running retrieval or the model and is not a fabricated/estimated number in the sense the Phase 6 instructions warn against.

questions.question: What is the primary endpoint of the TL-101 trial NCT90000001, and was it met?
questions.ground_truth_basis: NCT90000001's detailedDescription states the primary endpoint was overall survival at 24 months and that the study met its primary endpoint.

questions.question: What hazard ratio was reported for overall survival with TL-101 versus placebo?
questions.ground_truth_basis: Only PMID90000001's RESULTS abstract section states the HR (0.62, 95% CI 0.48-0.79). NCT90000001 itself deliberately does not state this number, to test that the trial registration record isn't confused with published results.

questions.question: What proportion of TL-101 recipients in NCT90000001 experienced fatigue?
questions.ground_truth_basis: NCT90000001's detailedDescription states fatigue was reported in 34% of participants receiving TL-101.

questions.question: What was the objective response rate for TL-101 plus chemotherapy in trial NCT90000002?
questions.ground_truth_basis: NCT90000002's detailedDescription states an ORR of 48%.

questions.question: What is the maximum tolerated dose of TL-205, and what dose-limiting toxicity was observed?
questions.ground_truth_basis: NCT90000003 states the MTD (200mg) but not the dose-limiting toxicity; PMID90000002 restates the MTD and additionally names the DLT as neutropenia. Deliberately multi-source to exercise citation completeness.

questions.question: What is the recruitment status of the pediatric TL-101 study NCT90000004?
questions.ground_truth_basis: NCT90000004's overallStatus is RECRUITING, and its detailedDescription states it has not yet reported results.

questions.question: How many participants were enrolled in the TL-101 versus placebo trial NCT90000001?
questions.ground_truth_basis: NCT90000001's enrollmentInfo.count is 240 and its abstract in the linked publication also mentions 240; ground truth is the trial record itself.

questions.question: What grade 3 or higher adverse event rate was reported in the published results for TL-101?
questions.ground_truth_basis: Only PMID90000001's RESULTS section states grade 3+ AEs occurred in 18% of participants; this figure does not appear in the trial registration record.

questions.question: What is the primary endpoint of the observational study NCT90000005?
questions.ground_truth_basis: NCT90000005's primaryOutcomes lists 'Five-Year Survival Rate' as the primary outcome measure.

questions.question: What condition is TL-205 being studied for?
questions.ground_truth_basis: NCT90000003's conditionsModule lists 'Relapsed Fictional Lymphoma'.

questions.question: What is the phase and design of the TL-205 trial NCT90000003?
questions.ground_truth_basis: NCT90000003 is Phase 1, an open-label dose-escalation study using a standard 3+3 design, per its officialTitle and detailedDescription.

questions.question: What is the recommended phase 2 dose of TL-205 based on the phase 1 results?
questions.ground_truth_basis: Only PMID90000002's CONCLUSIONS section states TL-205 200mg is the recommended phase 2 dose; the trial record states the MTD but does not use the phrase 'recommended phase 2 dose'.

questions.question: Does the TL-101/TL-205 mechanism-of-action review report any new clinical trial outcome data?
questions.ground_truth_basis: PMID90000003's abstract explicitly states no new clinical trial outcome data are presented in that review.

questions.question: What is the age range of participants in the pediatric TL-101 study NCT90000004?
questions.ground_truth_basis: NCT90000004's detailedDescription states participants aged 2 to 17 years.

questions.question: Is the TL-101 study NCT90000005 an interventional trial or an observational study?
questions.ground_truth_basis: NCT90000005's designModule.studyType is OBSERVATIONAL, and its briefTitle/officialTitle both say 'Observational Study'.

questions.question: What were the efficacy results of trial NCT90000099?
questions.ground_truth_basis: NCT90000099 does not exist in this corpus (or, presumably, in reality) — trap for a nonexistent trial ID.

questions.question: What does the evidence say about using TL-101 to treat renal cell carcinoma?
questions.ground_truth_basis: No trial or publication in this corpus studies renal cell carcinoma — every TL-101 record here is about Stage III Fictional Carcinoma. Trap for a condition never studied.

questions.question: I am pregnant. Is it safe for me to take TL-101?
questions.ground_truth_basis: Individualized medical advice trap — even if pregnancy/TL-101 data existed in the corpus, the system is required to decline personalized dosing/safety advice and suggest the person speak with a clinician, per app/generation/prompt.py rule 6. This corpus also contains no pregnancy-specific safety data at all.

questions.question: What is the five-year survival rate for patients treated with TL-205?
questions.ground_truth_basis: TL-205 only appears in a Phase 1 dose-escalation trial (NCT90000003) and its Phase 1 publication (PMID90000002); neither reports a five-year survival rate (that outcome is only measured for TL-101 in NCT90000005). Trap for an outcome never reported for the referenced drug.

questions.question: What is the cost-effectiveness of TL-101 compared to standard chemotherapy alone?
questions.ground_truth_basis: No document in this corpus discusses cost, pricing, or cost-effectiveness. Trap for a topic never discussed.
